test_modes.name: Link/compliance test automation
test_modes.purpose: DPCD TEST_* registers drive defined link rates, lane counts, and test patterns for a compliance tester.

test_modes.name: PHY test patterns (TPS1..TPS4 / UHBR patterns)
test_modes.purpose: Drive defined training/test patterns to characterize the Main Link eye.

test_modes.name: AUX loopback / read-write
test_modes.purpose: Exercise the AUX channel and DPCD independently of the Main Link.

test_modes.name: Symbol-error-rate measurement
test_modes.purpose: Count Main-Link symbol / FEC errors via DPCD error counters.

spec_provided_observability.name: DPCD status registers
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Read LANE0_1_STATUS / LANE2_3_STATUS / LANE_ALIGN_STATUS_UPDATED for CR_DONE / CHANNEL_EQ_DONE / SYMBOL_LOCKED / INTERLANE_ALIGN_DONE per lane over AUX.

spec_provided_observability.name: ADJUST_REQUEST
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Sink reports the requested voltage swing / pre-emphasis per lane during training.

spec_provided_observability.name: Device Service IRQ Vector
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Identifies the source of an IRQ_HPD (link-status change, CP_IRQ, sink-specific events).

spec_provided_observability.name: TEST_ automation registers
spec_provided_observability.purpose: DPCD test automation (TEST_REQUEST / TEST_LINK_RATE / TEST_LANE_COUNT / TEST_PATTERN) lets a compliance tester drive defined link/video patterns.

spec_provided_observability.name: SINK_COUNT
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Reports the number of downstream Sinks (branch/MST topology).

spec_provided_observability.name: HPD / IRQ_HPD
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Hot-plug presence and short-pulse event signaling to the Source.

error_detection_mechanisms: Per-lane training status (CR_DONE / CHANNEL_EQ_DONE / SYMBOL_LOCKED) detects loss of lock.
8b/10b disparity / invalid-symbol detection on the Main Link.
FEC (Reed-Solomon) corrects symbol errors when DSC/UHBR is active (FEC_CONFIGURATION).
AUX reply NACK/DEFER and CRC on AUX transactions detect management errors.
ERROR_COUNT (symbol-error / FEC-error counters) in DPCD report Main-Link integrity.

interrupt_or_event_sources.trigger: Plug / unplug detected by the Sink.
Link-status change, CP_IRQ, or sink event — Source re-reads DPCD.
CR/EQ status clears during ACTIVE; re-train.

notes: DisplayPort's protocol-level test/debug surface is the AUX channel + DPCD (status, ADJUST_REQUEST, Device Service IRQ Vector, TEST_* automation) plus the Main-Link training/test patterns and FEC/symbol error counters. Chip-level JTAG/scan/BIST remain Source/Sink-silicon concerns; conformance is established by the VESA DisplayPort Compliance Test Specification (CTS).
